Name: Yet Another Harvest With Scythe Mod
Author: bcmpinc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Allows you to harvest all crops and forage using the scythe. They can also still be plucked, without having to press a toggle button (though this can be disabled in [code]config.json[/code]). Unlike other 'harvest with scythe' mods, this patch does not affect your save game. So it is possible to revert to the old behavior by simply removing this mod.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the [code]config.json[/code] file.[/i][list]
[*] [code]HarvestWithSword[/code]: Whether a sword can be used instead of a scythe. Default = false.
[*] [code]HarvestAllForage[/code]: Whether the scythe should work too on forage not above tilled soil. Default = true.
[*] [code]PluckingScythe[/code]: Whether you can still pluck plants with a scythe equipped. Allowed values: [code]NEVER[/code], [code]INVALID[/code] (only if the scythe cannot harvest it), [code]ALWAYS[/code].
[/list]Valid values for the following settings are: [code]NONE[/code] (crop cannot be harvested at all), [code]HAND[/code] (only pluckable), [code]IRID[/code] (vanilla behavior), [code]GOLD[/code] (harvestable with golden scythe) [code]BOTH[/code] (both pluckable and scythable), [code]SCYTHE[/code] (only harvestable with any scythe). Note that [code]NONE[/code] is only useful when using the Generic Mod Config Menu to change this setting in-game.[list]
[*] [code]PluckableCrops[/code]: How crops that normally can only be harvested by hand can be harvested. Default = BOTH.
[*] [code]ScythableCrops[/code]: How crops that normally can only be harvested with a scythe can be harvested. Default = SCYTHE.
[*] [code]Flowers[/code]: How flowers can be harvested. Default = BOTH.
[*] [code]Forage[/code]: How forage can be harvested. Default = BOTH.
[/list][size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[/list][size=4][b]Known bugs[/b][/size]
Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack/issues]GitHub[/url].[list]
[*] This mod is incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] and causes strange behavior in some circumstances. This cannot be fixed.
[*] This mod is probably incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10941]Don't stop me now[/url]. Right clicking forage causes the player to get stuck.
[*] When using a sword as scythe on grass it has a 0% of producing hay.
